items.title: Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 AI Agent Tried to Inject Malicious Code and Trick Real Developers
items.description: Anthropic has revealed how its Claude Mythos 5 AI agent tried to plant malicious code in a real GitHub project and used fake identities to persuade developers to approve it during a cybersecurity test run by the UK AI Security Institute (AISI). items.title: Palo Alto Confirms PHP RCE Vulnerabilities Impact PAN-OS and Multiple Network Products
items.description: Palo Alto Networks has confirmed that two critical PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities affect PAN-OS and previously impacted two cloud services. Tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, the flaws have prompted planned firewall hotfixes and guidance to restrict access to management interfaces.
